name: Dachshund70
status: proposed: pins chosen for PCB routing; update this file if the schematic changes them

usb.warning: pid.codes TEST PIDs: not unique, in-house testing only. Must not ship on boards that are sold or redistributed. Replace with a registered pid.codes PID first.

display.connector: J4, FH12-10S 10-way 0.5 mm FPC socket on the top side for the Sharp LS027B7DH01 tail, in the panel's pin order: 1 SCLK (clk) 2 SI (din) 3 SCS (cs, active high) 4 EXTCOMIN (dc) 5 DISP (rst) 6 VDDA 7 VDD 8 EXTMODE 9 VSS 10 VSSA
display.interface: SPI to the Sharp memory LCD; busy drives the enable of the on-board 5 V boost (U5 TPS61222, 100k pull-up)

power.batterySense: VDDH/5 internal SAADC channel (battery wired to VDDH); no GPIO

dongle.status: proposed: pins chosen for the hardware/Dachshund70-Dongle PCB; update this section if the schematic changes them
dongle.compatibility: Button and LED pins match Nordic's nRF52840 Dongle (PCA10059), so the dongle firmware can be developed on one

power.supply: USB VBUS feeds both VBUS and VDDH (high-voltage mode); DCCH is unconnected, so REG0 runs as an LDO
power.lfclk: no 32.768 kHz crystal: use the internal RC oscillator (LFRC) with calibration
